Name: Old Farmer Brand Laser Eye
Author: KyleFromPelicanTown
Description:
[b][size=4]Description[/size][/b]
Old Farmer Brand LaserEyes, you can use your eyes to emit laser light. to be homelander（I mean countrylander）.

[b][size=4]Installation instructions[/size][/b]
First, install SMAPI, then download and unzip this mod to the Mods folder in the game.
[heading][b][size=4]Main Features[/size][/b][/heading]
[list]
[*]Mr. Qi's Ginger Island store sells a formula for making compound V, priced at 18 Qi Gem.[/*]
[*]Materials: 18 Radioactive Bar + 18 Iridium Bar + 18 Large Milk + 18 Large Goat Milk  + 1 Prismatic Shard. [/*]
[*]After making compound V and equipping it in the jewelry store, you will receive a buff in full swing posture. [/*]
[*]Drinking a large pot of milk/goat milk will restore an additional 1/2 of physical strength, while drinking milk/goat milk will restore an additional 1/3 of physical strength. [/*]
[*]Left mouse button emits laser, emitting laser will consume physical energy. [/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Shout outs[/size][/b]
鹈鹕镇的小凯（创意、程序）、slllllqz（美术支持）
[line]
[b][size=4]介绍[/size][/b]
老农民牌镭射眼，你可以从你的眼里发射激光。

[b][size=4]安装说明[/size][/b]
先安装SMAPI，然后下载本Mod解压复制到游戏的 Mods 文件夹。

[b][size=4]主要功能[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]齐先生姜岛商店出售5号化合物制作配方，售价18齐钻。[/*]
[*]制作材料：18 个放射性矿锭 + 18 个铱锭 + 18 个大壶牛奶 + 18 个大壶羊奶 + 1 个五彩碎片。[/*]
[*]制作5号化合物后，装备到饰品栏，会获得全盛姿态buff。[/*]
[*]喝大壶牛奶/羊奶会额外回复1/2体力，喝牛奶/羊奶会额外回复1/3体力。[/*]
[*]鼠标左键发射激光，发射激光会消耗体力。[/*]
[/list][b][size=4]特别感谢[/size][/b]
